name.en: A surface made for a reset

description.en: A precision service mat, with pressed locating squares, recessed contacts and a terracotta return trace. Rules become a measured grid; recovery becomes one considered path.
description.zh: 精密检修垫上的压印方格、凹入触点与陶土色返回轨迹。用定位栅格承载规则，用一条有节制的路径表达恢复。

texture.framing: Use the complete square as one surface. The approved grooves meet the top edge, so do not claim seamless repetition. Full square specimens and contained background placements preserve the original canvas.
